query: Open a PR for this branch and submit it for review.
expected_behavior: Validates the current branch is a feature branch and stops if it is master, main, dev, or production
Ensures the working tree is clean and the branch is pushed (pushing with -u if there is no upstream)
Resolves the bundled review client and runs it BEFORE opening the PR, records a disposition per finding, and re-reviews at most once
Generates a conventional-format title under 70 chars and a structured body with Summary and Test plan sections, with no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with footer
Presents title and body for approval via AskUserQuestion, then creates the PR with gh pr create targeting master by default
Requests no automated reviewer and waits for none after the PR opens; posts the tron-retro comment, reports the PR URL and the local review outcome, and parks at the human approval gate
